maddeler.e:
اغرنديا (form IIIq)
# اِغْرَنْدَيَا (iḡrandayā) /iɣ.ran.da.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِغْرَنْدَى (iḡrandā)
# اُغْرُنْدِيَا (uḡrundiyā) /uɣ.run.di.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِغْرَنْدَى (iḡrandā)
# اِغْرَنْدِيَا (iḡrandiyā) /iɣ.ran.di.jaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِغْرَنْدَى (iḡrandā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
